theme: An open day in St. Pete, with the holiday bookings still waiting.
greeting: Good afternoon, Dan. The calendar's nearly behind you — just the NACD program at 1 — and the girls are with you and Mike at the cottage. The one thing still pulling at today is the holiday travel that's slipped past its booking windows.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Flagged p1 on your and Mike's board and overdue since Sep 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market — a refundable hold now takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: p2 on the board; both the Sep 30 decide-by and Oct 15 book-by have passed. Six people over three weeks across the holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year — pick domestic or international and book.

flagged.title: Managing Partner role surfaced
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert flags Synergy Management Group's Managing Partner opening — worth a look given the active search.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, an Evite update, and a couple of shop promos.
